build_system: Vite 8. Build command: npm run build. Dev server: npm run dev. No workspaces — single package at SmartRide-Web/.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured in package.json
test_command: npm run build (build is the only automated check)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from e:\Company Project\SmartRide\SmartRide-Web. Expect zero errors and a dist/ folder. Then run `npm run dev` and manually navigate to /, /vehicles, /bookings, /earnings, /profile, /settings, /documents to confirm visual output.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root is e:\Company Project\SmartRide\SmartRide-Web. All file edits must use absolute paths. npm commands must be run from that directory.
contribution_requirements: No new npm packages. Use only: React, React Router, Tanstack Query, Lucide React, Recharts, Zustand, Axios. Custom CSS only — no Tailwind. Admin pages must keep working.
key_patterns: Custom CSS in App.css using class names + CSS variables. No CSS modules. Components import './Component.jsx'. State via Zustand (useAuthStore). Data fetching via TanStack Query v5 (useQuery/useMutation). API calls via axios wrapper at src/services/api.js. All UI components in src/components/ui/. Pages in src/features/<name>/<Name>Page.jsx.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (router), src/App.css (all styles), src/index.css (font+root vars), src/components/layout/ (DashboardLayout), src/components/ui/ (StatCard, StatusPill, FilterBar, Modal, DataTable, PageState), src/features/<name>/ (page components), src/store/authStore.js (Zustand), src/services/api.js (axios), src/services/realtime.js (socket.io)
